rows.label: Concept
rows.text: The **cross product** a × b = |a||b|sin θ n̂ returns a vector perpendicular to both inputs (right-hand rule), computed mechanically as the 3×3 determinant with +−+ cofactor signs. It is **anticommutative** (order flips sign), distributive, and **zero exactly for parallel** vectors — the mirror of the dot product's perpendicularity criterion.…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
a × b = |î ĵ k̂; a₁ a₂ a₃; b₁ b₂ b₃| = (a₂b₃−a₃b₂, a₃b₁−a₁b₃, a₁b₂−a₂b₁)
a ∥ b ⟺ a × b = 0; a × b = −(b × a)
parallelogram area |a × b|; triangle area ½|a × b|; Lagrange: |a × b|² = |a|²|b|² − (a·b)²

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Treating the cross product as commutative; reversing the order negates the result.  ·  Confusing |a × b| with a · b: the former uses sin θ and is an area, the latter uses cos θ and is a scalar projection.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: The direction of a × b follows the right-hand rule: curl the fingers from a to b, the thumb gives n̂.  ·  A plane through a point p with direction vectors u and v has normal u × v and equation (r − p) · (u × v) = 0.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ***Half a parallelogram*** — the triangle with sides a, b is exactly half the parallelogram they span: Delta = (1/2)|a x b|; forgetting the half doubles every triangle-area answer.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Verified PYQs: NEB 2024 (|a x b| = 5 sqrt3; parallelogram area 5), NEB 2023 (a.b and |a x b| pair), NEB 2021 (Lagroute route 2 sqrt42), NEB 2020 (unit perpendicular (i - j)/sqrt2) — assigned to this row.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Determinant expansion: + - + cofactor signs. 2D cross: single k-hat component a1b2 - a2b1. Unit perpendicular to a plane: a x b normalised. |a x b| without angle: Lagrange sqrt(|a|^2|b|^2 - (a.b)^2).

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **NEB 2024 (verified PYQ): If a = 2î + 3ĵ − k̂ and b = î − ĵ + 2k̂, find |a × b|. (3m with a·b)** — **Determinant form:** a × b = |î ĵ k̂; 2 3 −1; 1 −1 2|. **Expand:** î[(3)(2) − (−1)(−1)] − ĵ[(2)(2) − (−1)(1)] + k̂[(2)(−1) − (3)(1)] = î(6 − 1) − ĵ(4 + 1) + k̂(−2 − 3) = **5î − 5ĵ − 5k̂**.…  ·  **NEB 2024 (verified PYQ): Find the area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides a = 2î + ĵ and b = î + 3ĵ. (3m)** — **2D shortcut:** with no k̂ components, the cross product reduces to its k̂ part: a × b = (a₁b₂ − a₂b₁)k̂ = (2·3 − 1·1)k̂ = **5k̂**.…

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: For |a x b| questions, compute the full cross product then its magnitude — the intermediate vector earns method marks even if only the length is asked.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: The cross product is the dot product's complement: cos th measures agreement, sin th measures perpendicular cooperation — and sin th doubles as the area ratio.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Cross product: a x b = |a||b| sin th n-hat (right-hand rule) = determinant |i j k; a1 a2 a3; b1 b2 b3|. Anticommutative: a x b = -(b x a); distributive; NOT associative with dot. Parallel criterion: a || b iff a x b = 0; a x a = 0.…

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Torque = r x F and angular momentum = r x p are cross products in physics clothing: perpendicular levers, right-hand directions.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — The Area Machine The **cross (vector) product** a × b returns a **vector**: magnitude |a||b|sin θ, direction perpendicular to both by the right-hand rule. Its theorems: anticommutativity, the parallel criterion a × b = 0, the area theorems (triangle and parallelogram), and the component determinant formula.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts ### 2.1 Definition and component form - **a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂**, n̂ perpendicular to both by the right-hand rule. - **Component form:** a × b = determinant |î ĵ k̂; a₁ a₂ a₃; b₁ b₂ b₃| = (a₂b₃ − a₃b₂)î + (a₃b₁ − a₁b₃)ĵ + (a₁b₂ − a₂b₁)k̂. - Cyclic basis products: î × ĵ = k̂, ĵ × k̂ = î, k̂ × î = ĵ; reversed order gives the negative.…  ·  ## 3. Scientific Definitions | Term | Scientific meaning | Example | |---|---|---| | **Cross product** | |a||b|sin θ n̂ — a vector | î × ĵ = k̂ | | **Anticommutativity** | Swapping order flips the sign | b × a = −a × b | | **Right-hand rule** | Curl fingers a→b; thumb gives n̂ | fixes the perpendicular's direction | | **Parallelogram area** | |a × b| with adjacent sides a, b |…

Detailed Explanation ### 4.1 Why sin θ - The cross product measures *perpendicular cooperation*: full strength at right angles (sin 90° = 1), nothing when parallel (sin 0 = 0). rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ## 6. Common Confusions **Anticommutative, not commutative:** swapping inputs negates the output — a sign error here poisons every downstream result.  ·  **The middle component's sign:** (a₃b₁ − a₁b₃) — students write a₁b₃ − a₃b₁ and lose the ĵ component.  ·  **Area of triangle = half the parallelogram:** Δ = ½|a × b| — forgetting the ½ doubles the answer.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ## 7. Exam Application **NEB 2024 (verified PYQ): If a = 2î + 3ĵ − k̂ and b = î − ĵ + 2k̂, find |a × b|. (part of 3m)** — a × b = |î ĵ k̂; 2 3 −1; 1 −1 2| = î[(3)(2) − (−1)(−1)] − ĵ[(2)(2) − (−1)(1)] + k̂[(2)(−1) − (3)(1)] = î(6 − 1) − ĵ(4 + 1) + k̂(−2 − 3) = **5î − 5ĵ − 5k̂**. |a × b| = √(25 + 25 + 25) = **5√3**.  ·  **NEB 2024 (verified PYQ): Find the area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides a = 2î + ĵ and b = î + 3ĵ. (3m)** — a × b = (a₁b₂ − a₂b₁)k̂ = (2·3 − 1·1)k̂ = **5k̂** (2D shortcut: only the k̂ component survives). **Area = |a × b| = 5 square units.**  ·  **NEB 2020 (verified PYQ): Find a unit vector perpendicular to the plane containing a = î + ĵ and b = ĵ + k̂. (part of 4m)** — A perpendicular to the plane is parallel to **a × b**: a × b = î[(1)(1) − (0)(1)] − ĵ[(1)(1) − (0)(1)] + k̂[(1)(1) − (1)(1)] = î − ĵ + 0k̂ = **î − ĵ**. |î − ĵ| = √2.…
